summary: Added an optional `theme` prop ('light' | 'dark' | 'system') and exported `ResponsiveTableTheme` type. New useResolvedTheme hook (SSR-safe: starts light, reads body.dark via MutationObserver or matchMedia only in effects, cleans up) and a ThemeRoot wrapper div (class, data-rt-theme, color-scheme) around the skeleton, error and main render paths. Colour variables moved from the <table> class to Theme.module.css on the wrapper with light (unchanged) and dark values; hard-coded colours (sorted header, selected row, skeleton/shimmer, spinner track, detail pane, sort icons via masks, no-data icon, error panel, filter clear button) now use variables. Version 0.20.0, CHANGELOG and docs updated (README, api, features, examples, configuration, development, breaking-changes). Baseline suite passed (67) before changes; now 90 tests pass, tsc clean, rollup build succeeds. Note: .size-limit.json and scripts/check-docs.mjs do not exist in this project, so those checks were not run; package.json test runner is Jest (not Vitest).
